image_description: A medium shot of a Blue Monkey (Cercopithecus mitis), a type of guenon, perched on a thick tree branch. The monkey has dark grey/blue fur on its back and limbs, with a lighter grey/white chest and throat. Its face is dark with a distinctive pale brow band and light-colored eyes. A chain-link fence is visible in the background, suggesting a zoo or enclosure setting.

While eyes are forward-facing, the irises appear distinctly yellow/amber, not brown as specified in the strict checkpoint description.
The nose structure is narrow and typical of Old World monkeys.
Ears are small and partially obscured by the facial ruff, consistent with the species.
